description: Convert an AVI video (base64, max 15 MB) into a universal H.264/AAC MP4 with +faststart for web and mobile playback. Uses instant lossless remux when already H.264, otherwise transcodes with configurable CRF quality (19/23/28), optional resolution downscale (1080p/720p/480p), AAC audio or mute, yadif deinterlacing and metadata stripping. Deterministic local ffmpeg, 0 AI, nothing stored. Free: 5 calls/day per IP. Paid: Radar API key (from €15/mo at https://radarbg.com/pricing#starter via X-API-Key) or $0.004/call via x402 at https://radarbg.com/x402/avi-to-mp4.

audio.description: AAC audio bitrate (160/128 kbps) or mute

deinterlace.description: Apply yadif deinterlacing for interlaced camcorder/VHS AVI files

fileContent.description: Base64-encoded .avi video (max 15 MB; empty = built-in sample Xvid/MP3 AVI)
